name: session-bar
description: A calm session bar above the prompt: API cost (or API value on a subscription), 5h/7d limits, context, model, git and duration.

currency.title: Second currency code (optional)
currency.description: e.g. EUR. Leave empty to show USD only.

rate.title: Fixed rate: 1 USD = ? second currency
rate.description: e.g. 0.92. Shown next to the converted value. No live rates are fetched.
